status_reason: Critic verdict MAJOR (not fatal; no fabricated citations - all 5 dossier PMIDs real and unretracted). Data-miner interpretation 'weakens'. Do NOT advance any SMO-inhibitor repurposing proposal on current evidence. Three findings do the damage: (1) the drug target has no human genetic support - SMO, GLI1, PTCH1 and SHH each return ZERO COPD credible sets, gene-burden and ClinVar rows in Open Targets; their scores are literature-only (SMO 0.083). Genetic support for HHIP does not transfer to SMO, which sits downstream of an extracellular ligand sequesterer. (2) The core 'ongoing, not developmental' premise has no supporting experiment; no adult inducible Hhip deletion exists, and the best model (PMID 40333979, Sci Adv 2025) places the effect in alveologenesis with a NEONATAL HHIP-Fc rescue. (3) Novelty overstated: sub-claim N3 not N4 - TITLE_ABS gave 1 hit where full text gave 10, and PMID 36191777 (2022) already proposes Hh inhibition for genetically susceptible COPD.
statement: In adults, COPD risk from HHIP-expression-lowering alleles at 4q31 acts partly through ongoing mesenchymal Hedgehog activity; therefore SMO inhibition should be most protective against emphysema progression in HHIP risk-allele carriers.

queries.query: TITLE_ABS:(HHIP) AND TITLE_ABS:(vismodegib OR sonidegib) AND TITLE_ABS:(COPD OR emphysema)
(HHIP) AND (vismodegib OR sonidegib) AND (COPD OR emphysema)
cond=COPD OR emphysema; intr=vismodegib OR sonidegib OR glasdegib OR smoothened

disputed.critic: Contradicted. Human tissue shows Hh deficient/down in COPD EPITHELIUM (PMID 31877414, 30833624, 39844999) and GLI1 nuclear translocation is required for AT2 proliferation (PMID 42399584), so SMO inhibition predicts harm.
disputed.data_miner: Not falsified. HHIP loss -> Hh hyperactivation -> emphysema is coherent in the MESENCHYME (PMID 40333979), so SMO inhibition has the right sign; what is weakened is the adult-reversibility corollary.
disputed.resolution: Unresolved and compartment-dependent: epithelial vs mesenchymal Hh tone may run in opposite directions. This is the discriminating experiment, not a scoring disagreement.

competing_explanations: 4q31 is a lung-growth / airway-geometry locus (dysanapsis, fewer-larger alveoli). Body height is HHIP's dominant GWAS trait (29 of top 100; p<=1e-300) and 4 smoking-behaviour associations add pleiotropy, so an HHIP instrument cannot isolate adult alveolar Hh tone.
Adult human HHIP is epithelial and the causal 4q31 enhancer acts SMAD3-dependently and Hedgehog-INDEPENDENTLY (PMID 38417378); mesenchymal dominance is mouse-specific.
The causal molecular event may be splicing, not expression-lowering: HHIP is a top COPD coloc with a lung sQTL (PMID 40798880).
graveyard_check: No SMO-inhibitor trial in COPD or emphysema anywhere (2 apparent hits were false positives for 'chronic' - both chronic GVHD, both terminated). SMO inhibitors approved in oncology only (BCC, AML); vismodegib has a phase-2 IPF indication listed.
kill_criterion: NOT RUNNABLE FROM PUBLIC DATA. All 39 Open Targets COPD credible sets and all 15 GWAS Catalog respiratory associations mapped to HHIP are cross-sectional baseline spirometry or prevalent case-control; decline/progression traits = 0. Public summary statistics therefore cannot separate reduced peak lung growth (developmental, untreatable in adults) from ongoing adult Hh activity (treatable). The real test needs longitudinal decline GWAS (COPDGene/SPIROMICS/CHARGE), largely controlled-access.
cheapest_test: Donor-level PSEUDOBULK Hh target-gene score (GLI1/PTCH1) in adult COPD vs control lung, split by mesenchymal vs epithelial compartment (CELLxGENE Census ~90k COPD lung cells, HLCA 6f6d381a-7701-4781-935c-db10d30de293), with tissue source (transplant explant vs resection margin) as covariate and dataset as random effect. Elevated mesenchymal GLI1/PTCH1 would be the first evidence of ONGOING Hh activity; unchanged or reduced would kill the adult-intervention claim. In parallel: a SMO/PTCH1/GLI2 cis-instrument drug-target MR, since zero genetic support for the drug target is the biggest hole.

unresolved: direction-of-effect conflict unresolved and compartment-dependent (see disputed)
no adult inducible Hhip deletion exists anywhere
SMO/GLI1/PTCH1/SHH have zero COPD genetic evidence
no HHIP lung cis-eQTL in GTEx v8 or v10, so the originally nominated coloc is not executable
FAERS for vismodegib/sonidegib dominated by muscle spasms, raised CPK, dysgeusia and weight loss - worst-case profile in sarcopenic cachectic elderly patients
kill criterion as written is confounded with power

notes: First ledger entry; a smoke test used to validate the pipeline rather than a serious proposal. Both reviewers independently reproduced the direction-of-effect and novelty checks. Its failure is now the worked example in discovery-methods.md s10, and the TITLE_ABS novelty artefact is now a hard rule in s6.
